patches.old_text: The Tax ID Element is a Stripe UI component for collecting customer business tax IDs. It's used to calculate sales tax accurately and to display tax IDs on invoices. It supports 100+ countries across 6 regions and works with both the Checkout Sessions API and Payment Intents API.
